queries: OpenAI Anthropic cancel compute commitments excess capacity 2026
OpenAI scales back Stargate compute commitments renegotiate 2026

sources_considered.why: Summarizes Anthropic's S-1: large committed compute, past under-estimation of needs, the risk of excess capacity, and current profit and cash.
Reports OpenAI dropping a planned Norway offtake and pausing a UK project.
Secondary report of an FT story on OpenAI shifting to leasing. Not read.
Secondary report on reduced spending targets. Not read.

receipt.public_excerpt: Anthropic also disclosed that it has significantly underestimated its compute requirements in the past, leaving it capacity constrained and impacting product development.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic names excess compute as a risk, but says its actual problem so far has been too little compute, not too much.

receipt.public_excerpt: Revenue has kept pace with compute expenses, and in its second quarter, the company generated $974 million in operating income. It also held $112.4 billion in cash and cash equivalents as of late June.

evidence_items.explanation: As of mid-2026, Anthropic was not unable to afford its compute. That does not rule out the forecast later.

receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI has abandoned plans to rent compute capacity directly from a Norwegian data center, days after confirming it paused a similar project in the U.K.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI pulled back from planned capacity, but the offtake deal was never signed, and OpenAI said it would rent the compute through Microsoft under existing contracts. This is not unneeded, unaffordable committed compute.

unresolved_gaps: No disclosure yet of either company writing down, cancelling, reselling, or defaulting on committed compute because of weak demand.
OpenAI's financial filings were not found or read.
